name: WPA Audio Library
purpose: Authorised audio and video reading of WPA-owned or explicitly licensed books, papers, working papers, journal articles and protocol notes.
rights_rule: A work may enter the audio library only when WPA/the author controls the necessary reading and publication rights or explicit permission is recorded.

READ_EXACTLY.label: READ EXACTLY
READ_EXACTLY.rule: Read the locked publication text verbatim. No paraphrase, additions, omissions or silent corrections.

AUTHORS_AUDIO_EDITION.label: AUTHOR'S AUDIO EDITION
AUTHORS_AUDIO_EDITION.rule: Preserve the publication meaning and wording while allowing approved spoken navigation such as chapter titles, figure notices, pauses and pronunciation cues. Any substantive textual change requires a new approved text version.

WPA_EXPLAINED.label: WPA EXPLAINED
WPA_EXPLAINED.rule: A separately scripted explanatory adaptation. It must never be presented as a verbatim reading of the source work.
